Robin Singh -----Petitioner
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others. …..Respondents
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Sri Pawan Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner. 
2. Sri Amarendra Pratap Singh, learned Additional Advocate General 
with Sri B.S. Parihar, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
3. The specific finding in the order of the Chief Education Officer, 
Pauri Garhwal dated 10.07.2026, inter alia, is that at the time of 
submitting application for appointment on the post of Principal, the 
petitioner relied upon M.Sc. Degree issued by Sikkim International 
University and B.Ed. Degree also issued by the same University, but 
during the course of inquiry, he relied upon certain testimonials issued by 
some other University. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has not clarified in the writ 
petition as to on which testimonials he succeeded in getting appointment 
on the post of Principal. 
5. The petitioner is directed to bring on record a copy of the 
application submitted by him for his appointment on the post of Principal 
and also the testimonials filed along with the said application. 
6. List after three weeks. 
7. Meanwhile, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the 
State of Uttarakhand shall also obtain instructions in the matter. 
 
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
 28.07.2026 28.07.2026
